_doc: H20-PDF-1106 repository-PDF route seed (records/plans/h20-repository-pdf-route.md, D-CFG). Read via list `repository.pdf_hosts` (config/list_tables.json). Exact-host allowlist: only rows with status `active` are used; `pending` and `retired` rows are never fetched. No wildcards, no suffix matching. Host: zenodo.org is the only first host (LSE removed: robots blocks AI assistants, OD-1106-ROBOTS-AI). Caps are required controls: a missing or invalid value falls back to the shipped default, never to no limit. Ships with the feature flag off (config/auto_acquire.json repository_pdf_route.enabled).
_calibration_note: All numeric caps are PROVISIONAL planner priors (OD-1106-NEWS, Q4 values stay provisional). Calibrate per cap from the D-MEM measurement (work/H20-PDF-1106/mem.md) and from trace bytes_bucket, pages, extract_ms and R-PDF-* counts on the first owner-approved live attempts. Record the change and its data in this file.

hosts.licence_source: record metadata licence field, through the unchanged licence gate
hosts._rate_portal_note: Set by D-RATE (config/rate_limits.json, new portal key). Stricter of terms and crawl_delay_s 10 applies.
hosts._evidence_note: Path to the D-HOST research note once it exists. Owner approval is needed before status becomes active.

max_pdf_bytes.unit: bytes (15 MiB, wire and stream cap)
max_pdf_bytes._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. PRIOR: typical article PDFs are under 5 MB; 3x headroom. Calibrate from trace bytes_bucket and the D-HOST sample. Raise if R-PDF-SIZE exceeds 5% of attempts.

max_pages._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. PRIOR: long working papers and theses. Calibrate from the trace pages histogram and the R-PDF-PAGES share.

extract_wall_s.unit: seconds (wall clock for the child; also the child RLIMIT_CPU)
extract_wall_s._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. Fits inside the existing per_doc_timeout_s of 25. Calibrate from extract_ms p50 and p95 in the trace.

child_rlimit_cpu_s.unit: seconds of CPU time in the child
child_rlimit_cpu_s._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. Same as extract_wall_s. Calibrate with it.

child_rlimit_as_bytes.unit: bytes of address space (384 MiB) in the child; MEMORY CAP PLACEHOLDER
child_rlimit_as_bytes._calibration_note: PLACEHOLDER, NOT MEASURED. Set from the peak RSS of the worker on the fixtures and about 20 real open PDFs (D-MEM). Lower it if the container peak exceeds 90% of headroom.

max_concurrent_extractions._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. Memory bound on a 512 MB container. Calibrate from container memory metrics.

max_stream_decompressed_bytes._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL. Decompression-bomb control, set no higher than 64 MiB. Calibrate from the R-PDF-BOMB count.

max_output_text_bytes.unit: bytes of extracted text (same as config/public_fetch.json max_decompressed_bytes)
max_output_text_bytes._calibration_note: PROVISIONAL, existing bound reused. Calibrate from the R-PDF-TEXTCAP count.
